findings.problem: Drops the action. The chip is the pinned head of HOME_SUGGESTION_KEYS (always shown first), and tapping it stages its label in the composer as the prompt (home-splash.tsx onPress={() => onPick(label)}; home-copy.ts: 'a suggestion's tap REPLACES the field's text'). A bare noun phrase sent to the agent no longer asks it to turn anything on (it reads as 'tell me about phone access'), and the chip reads like a section heading next to five imperative siblings (Créez/Montrez/Configurez/Examinez/Réveillez-moi). Omission of the verb in an actionable control = accuracy + register defect.
findings.test_limit: SUGGESTION_CHAR_BUDGET.fr = 31 UTF-16 chars (home-copy.ts@9214ff9b l.93), asserted by home-copy.test.ts 'every suggestion fits its one-line row' (rendered.length <= budget). 31 is derived (24 x median fr/en ratio 1.30), not pixel-measured like es/ru/vi (32).
findings.suggested: Activez l’accès téléphone (25 chars, passes the test) — byte-identical to the desktop's own chip ui.chat.composer.suggestion.phone_access on local-operator-ui origin/main e612221450, so the same chip reads the same on both clients and the verb survives. The reference name « Accès depuis un téléphone » stays on headings/menu paths, where the desktop also uses it; the desktop itself uses the short form on this chip. If the full name is required on the chip, the only route is a code change: « Activez l’accès depuis un téléphone » (35) plus SUGGESTION_CHAR_BUDGET.fr raised to ≥35 with a measured width at 320 pt — out of translation scope.
